answer: An agent economy analyzing data across a polar tundra, orbital comet lander, and deep-space nebula array mitigates Sybil attacks through Proof of Burn. To participate in consensus, each agent must provably send base tokens to an unspendable verifier address. An attacker incurs an irreversible loss of scarce economic capital for every forged identity. However, this mechanism permanently destroys circulating liquidity and heavily disadvantages resource-constrained micro-agents.
